items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: When you did the 32 bars off Walter Bailey, you did a Pretty Foot in there.

ctx.x: It could be a contest dance, you see. (Recording interruption) The Cake Walk, Chuck, would be a sort of Pretty Foot.
That's it. That's the number one in Chocolate Dandy, the world, the Cake Walk, (unintelligible) Walter Bailey, (Geatty), see. (Recording interruption)
I would really love to see the Pretty Foot, Chuck, if you can do it for us.
